summary: AstroNova, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce that its Board fixed July 20, 2026 as the date of its 2026 Annual Meeting, with a May 21, 2026 record date. No material corporate transaction, shareholder activism, or strategic event is disclosed. The filing is a routine procedural notice with no deal terms, recommendations, or advisers mentioned. As this is an ordinary current report about a scheduled meeting, it does not qualify as any special-situation category. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
